verdicts.reason: In A, the stacked 'Spa Utopia' headline is tiny and barely stands out. 'Weekly SPA items review' sits on the glass jar and leaves, so it is low-contrast, almost as large as the headline, and hard to read. The tagline also drifts far from the headline, so the two don't read as one group. In B, the one-line 'Spa Utopia' headline is large and reads clearly as the main message, but the 'S' collides with the green bottle and the line runs across the glass dish. The tagline breaks awkwardly into 'Weekly SPA / items review' and sits on busy leaves, where it is nearly illegible. B is less bad because its hierarchy is clearer.
